clips.title: The story
paras: Deathguard Dillinger sends you west from Brill to hold the old bridge against the Scourge. Bring back proof that the dead are destroyed, and Tirisfal's defenders can keep the road clear.

Brill guards a crossroads in eastern Tirisfal Glades, where an enemy approach threatens the Forsaken stronghold. Scourge wander west across the waterways and gather around the broken old stone bridge. Without patrols to drive them back, the shambling dead could block travel between Brill and the western farmsteads.

For the Forsaken, Scourge on their borders are more than a threat to defend against. Each mindless ghoul and rotting corpse recalls the servitude and torment they escaped under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. Deathguards like Dillinger take grim satisfaction in crushing their former captors. They demand severed claws as proof that the mindless dead have been put to rest for good.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Scourge have trickled into Tirisfal Glades and have infested the area west of Brill, near the old bridge.
Go there and beat back the rotting dead and ravaged corpses you find. Scatter their bones and bring back their putrid claws, and the Deathguards will reward you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you? Do you have those putrid claws?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done. I regret not being there to see you smash those undead into rotting pulp!
